plugins.name: postzen
plugins.description: Schedule and publish social media posts across 10 platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram) from Claude Code, with queue management and analytics reports.

skills.name: analytics
skills.description: Build a social media analytics report from PostZen — post performance, follower growth, daily metrics, and best times to post across connected accounts. Use when the user asks how their posts or accounts are performing.
skills.description_zh: 根据 PostZen 数据生成社交分析报告，覆盖连接账号的帖子表现、粉丝增长、每日指标和最佳发布时间，适用于帖子或账号表现查询。

skills.name: connect
skills.description: Connect a new social media account to PostZen (X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram) or review/disconnect existing connections.
headings: Connect a social account to PostZen
skills.description_zh: 连接新的社交账号到 PostZen，或查看及断开现有连接；原说明列出 X、Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn、Facebook、YouTube、Threads、Pinterest、Bluesky 和 Telegram。

skills.name: post
skills.description: Create, schedule, or queue a social media post with PostZen. Use when the user wants to post, schedule, cross-post, or draft content for X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, or Telegram.
skills.description_zh: 使用 PostZen 创建、排期或入队社交帖子，也可制作草稿及跨平台发布；原说明支持 X、Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn、Facebook、YouTube、Threads、Pinterest、Bluesky 和 Telegram。

skills.name: queue
skills.description: Set up and manage PostZen posting queues — recurring time slots that posts fill automatically. Use when the user wants to create, review, or reorganize their posting schedule, see upcoming slots, or post at their best-performing times.
skills.description_zh: 设置和管理 PostZen 发布队列，让帖子自动填入周期时段；适用于新建、检查或调整排期，查看将来时段，以及按表现较好的时间发布。
